message.content:
{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: golangci-lint
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - main
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  golangci:
    name: lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: go.mod
          cache: false
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
      - name: golangci-lint
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v8
        with:
          version: v2.11
", "rationale": "The workflow is a Go lint job and the repository provides go.mod and go.sum, so dependency fetching is repeatable and cache-keyable by the lockfiles. setup-go is configured with cache: false, meaning no equivalent dependency cache currently exists, satisfying the P-LIT-GHA-CACHE precondition and avoiding the "equivalent cache already exists" contraindication. The matching measured experiment (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) added actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod keyed on hashFiles('go.mod','go.sum') and preserved all checks with equal success while reducing median elapsed time. Adding the same cache step after checkout preserves the lint coverage, changes no permissions, adds no secrets, publishing, deployment, or new network access beyond the standard Actions cache service.", "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]}
